chunks: From him, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād, from al-Ḥalabī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
He was asked about a man who receives from zakat: is the sadaqat al-fiṭrah due upon him? He said: No.

key_terms.رَجُلٍ: a man; a legal case under discussion
key_terms.صَدَقَةُ ٱلْفِطْرَةِ: the alms of fiṭrah due at the end of Ramadan
key_terms.ٱلزَّكَاةِ: zakat; obligatory alms given to eligible recipients

ai.seo_question: Is sadaqat al-fiṭrah obligatory on someone who receives zakat?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling that the poor person who receives zakat is not liable for sadaqat al-fiṭrah. It indicates the dropping of fiṭrah from one who is needy and among the recipients of zakat.
